Id.description: B generated opaque case-sensitive identifier; never trim.

Version.description: Server additionally enforces <=9223372036854775807. Never convert to JS Number.

Password.description: Never trim or log; encoder byte-length limits must be explicit.

ImageUrl.description: HTTPS URI with valid host, no userinfo or whitespace; B never fetches remote images.

accessToken.description: JWT kept only in frontend memory; refresh token never appears in JSON.

goodsName.description: Leading/trailing whitespace removed. Server additionally enforces 1..128 UTF-16 code units, matching A String.length; supplementary emoji typically use two. Standard maxLength is only the necessary Unicode-character upper bound.

description.description: Plain text; HTML tags rejected, whitespace and newlines preserved.
